planCards.heading: Choose a plan
planCards.subheading: Pick a plan to see exactly what would change: nothing is modified without your confirmation.

downgradeDialog.title: Downgrade to {plan}
downgradeDialog.subtitle: Your {plan} plan stays active until {date}
downgradeDialog.intro: Here is exactly what will happen if you confirm:
downgradeDialog.effectiveBodyTrial: At the end of your trial period: no invoice will be issued.
downgradeDialog.effectiveBodyPaid: At the end of the period already paid for. No refund, no further invoice after that.
downgradeDialog.capTitleOver: Your {count} students stay, but no new enrolments beyond {cap}
downgradeDialog.capBodyOver: Starter is capped at {cap} students: the {count} existing records stay accessible and editable, but no new enrolment while you exceed {cap}.
downgradeDialog.capBodyUnder: You currently have {count}: you’ll still be able to enrol {remaining} more.
downgradeDialog.dataKeptBody: Students, grades, report cards, attendance, fees, timetable: nothing is locked or deleted.
downgradeDialog.invoicesBody: History stays viewable here and in the Stripe portal.
downgradeDialog.resumeBody: Change your mind before then: one click on “Resume {plan}” cancels the downgrade with no new invoice.
downgradeDialog.confirm: Downgrade at the end of the period

paymentMethodCard.title: Payment method
paymentMethodCard.defaultEditable: Default · editable in the secure Stripe portal
paymentMethodCard.clientNoSub: Stripe customer created · no active subscription
paymentMethodCard.starterFreeNote: The Starter plan is free: no card required
paymentMethodCard.secureNotice: Secure payments via Stripe (256-bit SSL, PCI-DSS level 1)
paymentMethodCard.secureNotice2: Payment happens on a dedicated secure Stripe page: your card details never pass through our servers.

billingHistoryTable.title: Billing history
billingHistoryTable.emptyStarter: The Starter plan is free: your invoices will appear here after you switch to {plan}.
billingHistoryTable.emptyOther: Your invoices will appear here after the first charge.

planTransition.resumeHint: Downgrade to Starter scheduled for {date}: resume before then to keep {plan} without interruption or a new invoice.
planTransition.currentStarterSuspended: Your school reverted to Starter: the {plan} subscription is suspended for non-payment. Select {plan} to fix it.
planTransition.currentStarter: You’re on the free Starter plan: up to {cap} students, no card required. Select another plan to see what would change.
planTransition.currentProTrial: {plan} is in its trial period until {date}: first invoice on that date ({estimate}).
planTransition.currentEnterprise: Enterprise contract in progress: your account manager handles plan changes.
planTransition.requestQuoteHint: Quote-based: volume pricing beyond 1000 students, multiple schools, dedicated onboarding and support. Tell us about your network ({students} today) and we’ll get back to you within 48h.
planTransition.managedByContractHint: Your school is under an Enterprise contract: plan changes go through your account manager, not self-service.
planTransition.managedByContractDisabled: Plan managed by your Enterprise contract
planTransition.regularizeHint: {plan} subscription suspended for non-payment: update your card in the Stripe portal: the plan is restored as soon as payment goes through (your {students} are kept).
planTransition.contactSuspendedHint: {plan} subscription suspended by the Schoolgesti team: write to us to restore it.
planTransition.unavailableHint: Online billing isn’t enabled on this deployment yet: contact us to switch to {plan}.
planTransition.reactivateHint: Immediate reactivation, no new trial: {estimate}, billed as soon as you confirm. Your data hasn’t moved.
planTransition.upgradeHint: Free {days}-day trial, no card charged until it ends. Then {estimate}: seats match your actual headcount, no commitment, cancel anytime.
planTransition.managedManuallyHint: Your {plan} plan was activated manually by the Schoolgesti team: contact us to change it.
planTransition.downgradeScheduledHint: Downgrade to Starter scheduled for {date}: {plan} stays active until then. Cancel it to continue without interruption.
planTransition.downgradeEffective: Takes effect on {date}, at the end of the period already paid for (no refund, no further invoice after that).
planTransition.downgradeOver: You have {students}: they all stay accessible, but no new enrolment while you exceed {cap}.
planTransition.downgradeUnder: The {cap}-student cap will apply again (you currently have {count}).
planTransition.downgradeSuffix: Data and modules stay accessible; you can resume until that date.
planTransition.salesEnterpriseBody: We’d like a quote for the Enterprise plan.
planTransition.salesSupportBody: We need help with our subscription.

screen.title: Subscription & Billing
screen.subtitle: Manage your plan, track your usage, and view your invoices.
screen.restrictedBody: The subscription, billed amounts, and receipts are only visible to the school owner and administrators. Reach out to them with any plan questions.
screen.alertProSuspendedStripe: {plan} subscription suspended for non-payment: your school reverted to the free plan’s rules (50 students). Update your card to restore {plan} immediately; your data has not moved.
screen.alertProSuspendedManual: {plan} subscription suspended by the Schoolgesti team: your school is applying the free plan’s rules. Contact us to restore it.
screen.alertPastDue: Your last payment failed. Update your payment method to keep the {plan} plan: access stays open in the meantime.
screen.alertTrial: Free trial in progress: first billing on {date}.
screen.alertDowngradeScheduled: Downgrade to Starter scheduled for {date}: {plan} stays active until then, then your school automatically reverts to the free plan (50 students). No new invoice will be issued.
screen.alertAtHardLimit: You’ve reached the {limit}-student limit of the free plan. Switch to the {plan} plan to add more.
screen.alertNearHardLimit: {count} / {limit} students: your free plan is nearing its limit. Consider switching to {plan} to keep enrolling.
screen.alertOverSoftLimit: You manage more than {limit} students: the Enterprise plan (volume pricing, dedicated support) is built for you.
screen.alertStripeNotConfigured: Online billing isn’t enabled on this deployment yet: contact us to switch to {plan}.
screen.manageBody: Switch cycle or downgrade directly here. Payment method and invoices are managed in the secure Stripe portal.
screen.confirmResume: Resume {plan}? The scheduled downgrade will be canceled: no new invoice, your cycle continues normally.
screen.confirmInterval: Confirm switching to {cycle} billing? The change is prorated immediately by Stripe.
screen.loadErrorNoSchool: No school linked to this account.
screen.loadErrorRestricted: Billing is reserved for the school's administrators.

help.pageOverview: Manage your school's plan, track usage against the limits included in your plan, and find your invoices: everything is updated live from Stripe.
help.manageProration: Switching your billing cycle is prorated and billed immediately by Stripe. A downgrade, on the other hand, only takes effect at the end of the period you've already paid for: no refund, but no loss of access before that date.
